import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SCRIPT_DIR = ROOT / "scripts"
sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPT_DIR))
SCRIPT_PATH = SCRIPT_DIR / "validate_seed_task_contracts.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("seed_task_contracts", SCRIPT_PATH)
MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
assert SPEC and SPEC.loader
sys.modules[SPEC.name] = MODULE
SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)


class TypeScriptRuntimeSeedTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        source = json.loads(
            (ROOT / "db" / "seeds" / "test" / "sources" / "engine-ts-runtime-fixtures.json").read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )
        self.task = source["lessons"][0]["tasks"][0]
        self.contract = self.task["code_structure"]

    def test_literal_solution_satisfies_static_and_runtime_stages(self):
        workspace = {"main.ts": 'console.log("Hello, Ada!");\n'}

        self.assertTrue(MODULE.validate_validation_contract(self.task, self.contract, workspace))

    def test_starter_and_superficial_answer_do_not_satisfy_runtime(self):
        cases = (
            "// Write your solution here.\n",
            '// Expected output: Hello, Ada!\nconsole.log("TODO");\n',
            'const expected: string = "Hello, Ada!";\n',
        )

        for source in cases:
            with self.subTest(source=source):
                self.assertFalse(
                    MODULE.validate_validation_contract(self.task, self.contract, {"main.ts": source})
                )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
